{{Quote|There's a new danger to SPIN. Several enemy probe droids have recently penetrated Yavin Four's Air Defense Network.|[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]|<ref name="The Lost City of the Jedi">''[[The Lost City of the Jedi]]''</ref>}}
The '''Air Defense Network''' was a set of weapon systems designed by the fledgling [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to nullify or reduce the effectiveness of hostile air action against its temporary [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].
